name: Hiiragi Mio
source:
A solemn and beautiful girl, Mio is Ryo's girlfriend. As the class president, she's earned the trust of her classmates, but she has a clumsy side to her personality as well (which she doesn't want others to find out). When Ryo's life force leaves his body, she finds him unconscious and is very worried. 

Mio excels at school (especially Science & Mathematics) and is a good cook. Her only weakness is sports.
